name: ostler
description: A local-first project manager for Windows, with AI agents as an optional layer.
author: Ostler

scripts.package:dir: npm run rebuild:native && npm run build && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run rebuild:native && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.monkey.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-brand.cjs && node scripts/check-hygiene.cjs && node scripts/check-workflows.cjs && node scripts/check-sync-core.cjs && node scripts/check-design-tokens.cjs && node scripts/check-i18n.cjs && node scripts/generate-shortcuts-doc.cjs --check && node scripts/generate-third-party-notices.cjs --check && eslint .
scripts.test: npm run rebuild:test && vitest run tests/unit
scripts.test:integration: npm run rebuild:test && vitest run tests/integration/automation/ tests/integration/harness-workflow.test.ts tests/integration/harness-http-server.test.ts
